prompt: Recreate only the compact Asana goal-period picker in the primary crop. Beneath it, make a half-year row with a small left chevron outside two equal outlined buttons 「上半期」 and 「下半期」, then a small right chevron outside the row. Beneath that, make four evenly spaced quarter buttons in one row, labeled exactly 「第1四半期」 「第2四半期」 「第3四半期」 「第4四半期」. The fourth quarter is selected: use the source's very light blue fill and blue outline, not the mock's green selection. Match the original control widths, gaps, row heights, alignments, corner radii, and compact regular Meiryo-style Japanese typography. Do not add a title, submit button, icons beyond the two chevrons, dates, periods, or other content. The original Asana crop controls geometry, palette, selected state and visible English content; the Japanese mock supplies translated labels and date wording only. This is a raster candidate, not native-editability or working behavior.
